pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Physical Aspect of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Physical Aspect of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Physical Aspect of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Physical Aspect of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical Aspect of Yoga.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Medicinal Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Medicinal Trees.
   B. Say Medicinal Trees has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Medicinal Trees with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Medicinal Trees to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Stories and Family Values? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scriptural Stories and Family Values has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Stories and Family Values.
   C. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Stories and Family Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Scriptural Stories and Family Values to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
   D. Use Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. Which response best shows understanding of Friendship and Keeping Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Use Friendship and Keeping Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Friendship and Keeping Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Friendship and Keeping Promises has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Friendship and Keeping Promises.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship and Keeping Promises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Physical Aspect of Yoga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Medicinal Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptural Stories and Family Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship and Keeping Promises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
